name: Physostegia

project_scope.selection_mode: B095 canonical/provisional anchors + B154 strict-review handoff
project_scope.note: P. correllii range PASS; P. virginiana PROVISIONAL; P. angustifolia user-approved learner entry but range UNRESOLVED with two verified target counties. Earlier pending-review status is retained historically, not treated as a missing species.

priority: accepted taxon/subspecies concept before using range
study_strategy.warning: Do not infer native status from an obedient-plant occurrence near development or plantings. P. virginiana is explicitly provisional and the Hays record is introduced; P. angustifolia still needs strict review.

quick_key.if: tall rhizomatous wetland perennial, often >1 m, narrow opposite leaves and long pink-purple flower spike on stream/river edges
upright rhizomatous obedient plant with opposite toothed leaves and dense pink-lavender spike but local taxon/range concept unresolved
quick_key.then: Physostegia virginiana — provisional learner, native metrics excluded

quick_key.if: source says Physostegia angustifolia / narrowleaf false dragonhead
quick_key.then: pending strict taxonomy + target-zone range review; no canonical install yet

look_here_first: Recognize Physostegia by opposite leaves, square stems, and a terminal spike bearing tubular two-lipped flowers in repeated clusters. Find the CALYX behind a flower and a LEAF NODE on the same stem. Compare leaf width, flower spacing and the entire plant in its habitat; do not identify a rare species from pink flowers or wet-ground habitat alone.

comparison_matrix.correllii: Pink-purple bilateral corollas along elongated spike
comparison_matrix.virginiana: Pink-lavender bilabiate flowers, relatively dense spike
comparison_matrix.angustifolia: Lavender/pink or pale corollas, repeated spike clusters; photo shows pale side view

comparison_matrix.correllii: Voucher-level characters; rare taxon, avoid habitat-only claim
comparison_matrix.virginiana: Texas taxon/subspecies concept and source of plant
comparison_matrix.angustifolia: Whole leaves + spike + precise county evidence

visual_lesson.title: Obedient plants: flower spike, leaf node, calyx

steps.name: 1. Whole plant and habitat
steps.rule: Distinguish aquatic-bank rhizomatous P. correllii from planted P. virginiana; habitat alone does not certify ID or nativity.

steps.name: 2. Opposite leaf pair
steps.rule: Trace both leaves to the same stem node; compare blade width and margins rather than only corolla color.

steps.name: 3. Side-on flower and calyx
steps.rule: Find tubular bilabiate corolla and separate green calyx at its base; look for flowers repeated in clusters along spike.

steps.name: 4. Blooming stem and mature fruit
steps.rule: Measure stalk and spike; photo of mature calyx/fruit still needed to teach this character.

local_photos.role: side-on flower/calyx reference; not whole-plant leaf comparison
